=== Morphological Assessment Form ===
A. Leaf Arrangement & Architecture
    1. Leaf relative position (alternate / opposite / whorled): opposite (clear paired leaves at each visible node along the stem, with nodes clearly visible in multiple images)

B. Leaf Complexity
    3. Leaf complexity (simple / compound): simple (each leaf is a single blade without divisions into leaflets)
    4. Compound leaf type, ONLY if leaf complexity is compound (odd-pinnate / even-pinnate): N/A

C. Leaf Morphology

    8. Leaf shape (elliptic, obovate, lanceolate, etc.): elliptic (broadest near the middle, tapering to both ends, with a rounded apex and base)

    10. Leaf base (rounded, cordate, cuneate): rounded (smooth, curved base without a distinct angle or notch)

    12. Secondary veins (visibility, spacing, number): visible, moderately spaced, 5-7 pairs per leaf (secondary veins clearly visible and running parallel to midrib, spaced evenly across leaf width)

D. Stem & Shoot Traits
    17. Stem type, may not be visible (woody / herbaceous): herbaceous (stem appears green, flexible, and non-woody, consistent across images)

    19. Stem color: green (uniform green coloration, consistent in all images)
    20. Stem texture (smooth / ridged / lenticellate): smooth (no visible ridges or lenticels; surface appears even)

    22. Latex, rarely visible but extremely diagnostic when present (present / not observed): not observed (no milky or colored sap visible when stem is broken or damaged)
